finding: Conductivity resolution is falsified as the cause of the O05-dry prescribed-qbot nonlinear-path drift. Restoring exact retention/capacity restores the analytical path, whereas restoring exact K does not.
scientific_implication: Derivative consistency between theta and C is necessary but not sufficient. A representation can preserve C=dtheta/dh internally and still perturb the local nonlinear map enough to alter Newton/backtracking behavior in a boundary-sensitive regime.
open_architecture_choice: Choose and prospectively qualify either a different solver-facing retention representation family or a bounded exact-retention fallback rule. Existing authority does not yet determine a general fallback trigger across materials and boundary regimes.
